requirements: Bind exact receipt and live reverified file hash plus immutable file identity before use; receipt/stat agreement alone is not this review rehashing2.644GB.

Declare whether the target is top2M frozen legacy-eligible IDs intersected with latest original prefix, or topN eligible reconstructed originals using frozen ranking; do not silently backfill or reduce scope.
Preserve unranked/unavailable/excluded original dispositions and missing-view facts; ranking eligibility from older FineWiki is not new original-source qualification.

dispositions: Every sequence through the frozen ceiling has exactly one explicit disposition with immutable member, offset, size, raw SHA and parsed identity or error.

Records and oversized are separate tables; join or merge their sequence ledgers. Missing/oversized identities cannot establish latest-page coverage and must deny qualification until explicitly resolved.
All duplicate originals retain provenance; conflicts attach to a page/revision rather than permanently poisoning later valid revisions.
Only complete verified reconstruction and rights/context gates can create admitted source; metadata-only selected rows remain engineering.
lifecycle: Bind fixed committed prefix identity and stage inode/schema/producer identity; verify metadata immutability across detached batches and final ledger digest.
Check absolute cutoff before identity hashing, at each hash chunk and throughout SQL via SQLite progress callback; final join/index/hash/close must remain within externally enforced stop deadlines.
Acquire exclusive ownership before output creation; refuse active resume and races; retain partial outputs on failure without promotion.
